comment: this is purelly a concept output, and can be changed at any time
status: string, ok | err, err cause in message
message: string, ok | {string}, where ok is used if status is ok, otherwise state reason for error.

present.comment: up to 3 supported languages: Python, JavaScript, Java. found by file extentions (primarily)
present.nfiles: int: number of files for specified language
present.share: float: percent of files that are of specified lang

suspected.comment: optional. if language suspected to be present, but can't be found explicitely, this should be present

languages.confidence: string: high | med | low, typically this would be high

size.filecount: int: number of files, excluding dependencies, .git, binaries and build files (non-code files basically)
size.loc: int: lines of code (across all files)

docs.comment: only present if documentation is found. README.md counts, but should be specified if its the only present documentation. Search for docs folder
docs.onlyREADME: boolean, true if only readme is found
locations: string list, one for each directory where documentation is found. includes '/', '/docs', etc
